events.title: US National Weather Service Active Alerts
events.region: Southern Blue Mountains; Central Mountains of Oregon
events.source_name: US National Weather Service Active Alerts
events.summary:
...WINDY AND BREEZY WITH CRITICAL RELATIVE HUMIDITY TODAY AND
SATURDAY...

The upper level low will eject into the region bringing windy
conditions to many of the Cascade Gaps as well as central OR.
Humidities both Friday and Saturday will be critical.

* AFFECTED AREA...Fire Weather Zones 698 Southern Blue Mountains
and 700 Central Mountains of Oregon.

* TIMING...From 1 PM this afternoon to 8 PM PDT Saturday.

* WINDS...West 10 to 20 mph with gusts up to 30 mph.

* RELATIVE HUMIDITY...As low as 8 percent.

* IMPACTS...Any fire that develops will catch and spread
quickly. Outdoor burning is not recommended.

events.title: US National Weather Service Active Alerts
events.region: Coastal waters from Surf City to Cape Fear NC out 20 nm; Waters from Surf City NC to Little River Inlet SC from 20 to 60 NM
events.source_name: US National Weather Service Active Alerts
events.summary:
SMWILM

The National Weather Service in Wilmington has issued a

* Special Marine Warning for...
Coastal waters from Surf City to Cape Fear NC out 20 nm...
Waters from Surf City NC to Little River Inlet SC from 20 to 60
NM...

* Until 530 AM EDT.

* At 428 AM EDT, severe thunderstorms capable of producing
waterspouts were located along a line extending from near 10 Mile
Rocks to near Sheepshead Rock. The severe thunderstorms were nearly
stationary.

HAZARD...Waterspouts and wind gusts 34 knots or greater.

SOURCE...Radar.

IMPACT...Waterspouts can easily overturn boats and create locally
hazardous seas. Small craft could be damaged in briefly
higher winds and suddenly higher waves.

* Locations impacted include...
10 Mile Boxcars, Liberty Ship, Dallas Rock, Masonboro Sea Buoy,
Harris Reef, 10 Mile Rocks, Kure Beach Point, School House Reef,
Sheepshead Rock, Buoy Off Carolina Beach, Topsail Boxcars, Wr2,
Dredge Wreck, 5 Mile Boxcars, South Masonboro Island, and Carolina
Beach.

events.title: US National Weather Service Active Alerts
events.source_name: US National Weather Service Active Alerts
events.summary:
* WHAT...Flooding caused by excessive rainfall is expected.

* WHERE...Chesterfield County in central South Carolina...

* WHEN...Until 715 AM EDT.

* IMPACTS...Minor flooding in low-lying and poor drainage areas.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...
- At 419 AM EDT, Doppler radar indicated heavy rain due to
thunderstorms. Minor flooding is ongoing or expected to begin
shortly in the advisory area. Between 1 and 2 inches of rain have
fallen.
- Additional rainfall amounts of 1 to 2 inches are expected over
the area. This additional rain will result in minor flooding.
- Some locations that will experience flooding include...
Cheraw, Pageland, Chesterfield, Carolina Sandhills Wildlife
Refuge, Cheraw Municipal Airport, Northeastern Technical College,
Cheraw State Park, Jefferson, Ruby, Patrick, Mount Croghan,
Chesterfield Ruby Middle School, Bay Springs Fire Station,
Chesterfield Detention Center, Cheraw Fish Hatchery, Central High
School and High Point Fire Station.
- http://www.weather.gov/safety/flood
